title: FA Metadata Header – Connector File
description: Defines the structure of a connector file that maps metadata sources (e.g. TIFF tags) to fields in the FAMH output document.

description.description: What this connector does and which tool or source format it targets

targetSchemaVersion.description: FAMH schema version this connector targets

mappings.description: Ordered list of source-to-target field mappings

mapping.description: A single field mapping from a source value to a target FAMH field. The reserved property 'transform' (not yet enforced) will reference a named transform from the transforms/ directory (e.g. "transform": "datetime-tiff-to-iso8601") once transform support is implemented.

source.description: Origin of the value to write to the target field

target.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the target field in the FAMH output document. Example: "/General Section/Image Width/Value"

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this mapping

required.description: Whether the mapping tool should error if the source value is absent

transform.description: Reserved for future use. ID of a transform from transforms/ to apply to the source value before writing to the target (e.g. "datetime-tiff-to-iso8601").

type.description: Read the value from a named TIFF tag

name.description: TIFF tag name as it appears in the 'tag' field of `famdo extract` output (Rust debug representation of the tag enum, e.g. "ImageWidth", "Make", "DateTime"). For unknown/private tags use the form "Unknown(id)" where id is the decimal tag number.

type.description: Inject a fixed literal value into the target field

value.description: The fixed value to write. May be a string, number, boolean, array, or object.
